description:
API usage totals between two calendar dates.
When to use: Audit call volume, reconcile billing, or answer how much API was used in a period.
Parameters: startDate and endDate — inclusive dates in YYYY-MM-DD (ISO 8601). endDate must be on or after startDate. Example: last 7 days — set startDate to today minus 6 days and endDate to today.
CREDITS: Does not spend validation credits.
name: get_api_usage
title: Get API usage
